## Open across themes

- [When do promising signals fail?](questions/failure-conditions.qmd): Failures cluster around ambiguity, entity resolution, evidence custody, scope changes, and over-tuned fusion, but no complete predictor exists.
- [How far can query-only routing go?](questions/query-only-routing.qmd): Dense query neighbors are a useful stable control, but candidate-side evidence improved development results.
- [How reliable must a generated reference be?](questions/reference-reliability.qmd): Gemini was the strongest reviewed default, but difficult and ambiguous cases still need selective escalation.
- [Can model responses provide useful ranking evidence?](questions/response-evidence.qmd): Direct lexical response retrieval underperformed; bounded refinement and reference-based paths have separate evidence.

## Highest-value next tests

- **Failure-aware evidence fusion** (`failure-aware-fusion`; `idea`; priority `high`): Select evidence sources using a query-level reliability signal.
- **Reference review trigger** (`reference-review-trigger`; `idea`; priority `high`): Predict which generated references need grounding or human review.
- **Semantic failure clusters** (`semantic-failure-clusters`; `idea`; priority `medium`): Group development failures to test whether recurring query types predict method weakness.
